name: Northern Migration
description:
Villagers are automatically recruited at no cost as long as there is spare Villager Capacity. Villager Capacity is increased by constructing more Longhouses.
Villager Capacity is at the maximum, Villager can no longer be recruited until more Longhouse are constructed.
descriptionCN:
只要村民容量有剩余，就会自动免费招募村民。建造更多长屋可以提升村民容量。
村民容量已达上限，无法继续招募村民。除非建造更多长屋。
